title: Recruitment Specialist
summary: Drive recruitment, talent acquisition and retention for a growing engineering group alongside HR and marketing.
description: Drive recruitment, talent acquisition and retention for a growing engineering group alongside HR and marketing.

sections.heading: Main Duties and Responsibilities
items: Manage end-to-end recruitment across departments and European locations, sourcing on LinkedIn and directly, coordinating interviews and candidate care.
Support employer branding, job-board and LinkedIn content, employee stories and recruitment campaigns.
Partner with HR on onboarding, exit feedback, internal mobility and retention.
Coordinate graduate, apprenticeship and placement schemes and education partnerships.
Track recruitment metrics and maintain compliant recruitment records.

sections.heading: Qualifications and Experience
items: Minimum two years' recruitment or talent coordination experience.
Proven end-to-end recruitment delivery and digital sourcing.
Strong writing, organisation and interpersonal skills.
Unrestricted right to work in EU without sponsorship.

sections.heading: Key Competencies & Desirable Attributes
items: Early-careers, engineering/technical and international recruitment experience desirable.
